(https://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0). Source: https://github.com/google/material-design-icons. Shipped with Beer CSS 5.0.3.
It is the single interface icon set for every page (tokens.css, .msi class). Not subset: the full ligature set keeps every icon name usable offline.
